notes.title: 🛠 Realife Simulator – v1.10.8 “Core Update” Developer Update
notes.content:
[h3]🔍 More Than Just an Update: A Core Overhaul[/h3][p]This release is not a simple patch—it's a [b]rebirth of the game’s core systems[/b]. Here are some of the highlights:[/p][hr][/hr][h3]🔄 Character System Fully Rewritten[/h3][list][*][p]Character animations, interaction logic, and data handling have all been rebuilt from the ground up.[/p][/*][*][p]The result is smoother movement, fewer bugs, and significantly better performance.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]⚙️ FPS & Performance Improvements[/h3][list][*][p]Critical issues like sudden FPS drops, input lag, and mini-freezes in certain map areas have been largely resolved.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]☁️ Fully Activated Dynamic Weather System[/h3][list][*][p]Time-of-day-based weather is now fully functional and not just visual. It directly affects driving, walking, and mission logic.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🚧 Death-Related Crashes Resolved[/h3][list][*][p]We’ve fixed rare but critical "death crash" issues reported by some players that caused the game to close upon dying.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]🚗 Vehicle Mechanics: Real Driving Simulation[/h2][p]v1.10.8 introduces a more immersive, physics-aware driving system:[/p][hr][/hr][h3]🚙 Realistic Driving System[/h3][list][*][p]Each vehicle now has unique handling, torque balance, and braking profiles for a more authentic experience.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]⛽ Advanced Fuel System[/h3][list][*][p]Fuel consumption now varies by vehicle type. Idling consumes gas too, adding realism and strategy.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🛠 Damage & Repair System[/h3][list][*][p]Cars can take damage from excessive use or collisions. Visit repair garages on the map to fix them.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]🎮 New Systems & UI Overhaul[/h2][hr][/hr][h3]🗃 New Inventory System[/h3][list][*][p]Drag-and-drop items, category filters, weight limits, and personalized sorting options are now available.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🧍‍♂️ Lean Mechanic[/h3][list][*][p]Characters can now lean around corners and cover—greatly enhancing RP server interactions.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]💬 Reworked Chat System[/h3][list][*][p]Cleaner and more readable interface. Includes separate channels for general, private, and RP messages.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🖥 Redesigned UI[/h3][list][*][p]The entire user interface has been reworked for simplicity, speed, and usability. Clean menus, lighter HUD, and faster interactions.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]⏳ New Loading Screen[/h3][list][*][p]Includes rotating tips, developer updates, and featured art from mod creators.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]📜 New Missions & System Features[/h2][hr][/hr][h3]📦 New Mission Types[/h3][list][*][p]RP-ready jobs like logistics, special delivery, technical assistance, and more are coming.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🔧 Backend System Upgrades[/h3][list][*][p]API and PHP foundations will soon allow players to [b]host their own servers[/b] with custom settings.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🔄 Modding Framework Initiated[/h3][list][*][p]Preliminary support for custom map, script, UI, and job mods has been integrated.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]📅 Estimated Release & Pricing[/h2][hr][/hr][h3]🎯 Estimated Release: [b]End of September 2025[/b][/h3][p]This is a forecast and may shift slightly based on testing and balancing phases.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]💰 Pricing Update[/h3][p]Due to the substantial content and technical improvements, a [b]price increase[/b] will be applied after this version’s release.
Players who purchase before the update will receive [b]all content for free[/b] going forward.[/p][hr][/hr][h2]🧠 Why It’s Worth the Wait[/h2][p]This update transforms Realife Simulator from a "game" into a [b]platform[/b]. (However, please know that it will not happen now but in the future.) A place where players can:[/p][list][*][p]Host their own rule-based servers[/p][/*][*][p]Use and develop Workshop mods[/p][/*][*][p]Build community-driven economies and experiences[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]🎙️ Final Words[/h2][p]With your feedback, we’re working daily to make Realife Simulator even better.
This massive update is built on months of development, rigorous testing, and a whole lot of love from the dev team.[/p][p]Please be patient and follow our [b]Discord[/b] for development news and early previews.[/p][p]Realife is rising to a whole new level and [b]you[/b] are part of that evolution.[/p][p][b]Thank you![/b]
[i]The Northenlight Studios Dev Team[/i][/p]

notes.title: Realife Simulator v1.10.7.1 Hotfix Notes
notes.content:
🌆 Map & Structural Changes

🏥 A brand new City Hospital has been added! The old hospital and the Whitehouse have been completely removed. In their place now stands a modern, large-scale medical complex.

🏙️ A new skyscraper has been added, contributing to the evolving and modernizing city skyline.

📍 Additional regional adjustments and environmental improvements were made to enrich immersion and visual variety.

🚌 Transportation & Driving Experience

🚍 Bus driving controls have been significantly improved! Expect smoother handling, more responsive input, and overall better control.

🛣️ Collision issues on the roads have been fixed. Vehicles should no longer clip through or get stuck in the environment.

🌤️ Dynamic Weather System (New!)

☁️ A time-based dynamic weather system is now active! The weather changes in real-time—go from clear skies to rain or fog dynamically.

🌧️ Random weather events are now more natural and varied, adding realism and immersion to the world.

⚙️ The system is not only visual—it’s designed to affect future gameplay elements like visibility and AI behavior.

✈️ The Skies Are Alive – Planes Are Now Flying!

🛫 Airplanes are now visible flying in the skies, adding life and depth to the game world.

🏗️ This is the first step toward the upcoming Airport System, which will feature flight missions and aerial gameplay mechanics.

🔧 Backend systems have begun preparation for air transport missions and related infrastructure.

🚀 Performance & Optimization

🧹 General performance optimizations were made to improve FPS and reduce memory usage.

⚙️ Lag and stutter issues especially on lower-end devices have been addressed.

💡 Backend cleanup and system refinements resulted in faster load times and smoother overall gameplay.

🔮 Coming Soon

✈️ Airport system and flight missions

👫 Cooperative events and weekly community challenges

🚍 New vehicles, improved AI traffic, and public transport integration

🎮 Make sure to update your game and check out the new hospital!
💬 Join our Discord to leave your feedback and be part of the community.

notes.title: Realife Simulator v1.10.7 Update
notes.content:
Hello Player's! 🎉
The v1.10.7 update brings brand-new features, jobs, and improvements to the game. Here’s what’s coming:

🚓 New Features

Police Station Added!
You can now interact with the police station for a more realistic city experience.

🎮 Gameplay & Character Adjustments

Reduced delays in character and general physics, making movements smoother.

Fixed weapon shooting issue: bullets now register properly, and damage is applied correctly.

Updated damage effects: realistic blood effects are now added where shots land, optimized for performance.

Reduced animation delays for melee weapons (knife, bat, etc.).

🚌 New Content

New Job: Bus Driver

A bus terminal has been added to the map. Get your bus from the terminal and start your routes.

Dynamic payment system: earnings depend on travel distance and the number of stops.

Passenger NPC system: passengers board at the terminal and get off at different stops.

🌍 World & Atmosphere

New bus stops have been added around the city, making the map feel more alive.

Improved night lighting: street lamps and building lights now look more natural.

Updated weather visuals: rain effects optimized for better performance.

📢 Notifications & HUD

A “Welcome” notification now appears when you first join the game.

Fixed the issue where the delivery HUD didn’t appear.

You can now change HUD and crosshair colors from the settings menu.

Small visual updates added to mission HUDs.

⚙️ Technical Improvements

Fixed mouse invert issue.

FPS stability improved with additional optimization.

Reduced unnecessary background system loads.

⭐ Extra Additions

Character walking and running animations reworked to look more natural.

Improved vehicle driving feel, especially braking mechanics.

Audio improvements: higher quality for gun sounds and environmental ambiance.

🔥 With this update, we fixed major issues while also enriching the world of Realife.
We’ll keep making the city better with your feedback!

notes.title: Realife Simulator v1.10.6
notes.content:
Realife Simulator v1.10.6 — Patch Notes

Hello Realife players,
We’re excited to announce the release of update v1.10.6, a version we’ve been working on for quite some time to bring you a smoother, more balanced, and more enjoyable experience. This update not only adds new content but also delivers major infrastructure improvements and resolves many long-standing issues.

🗺️ Navigation: Minimap + World Map + Waypoint

Minimap is now permanently displayed on the HUD.

World Map has been added (open with TAB).

Waypoint system is now active: create routes directly on the map or auto-mark objectives from the mission panel.

Added zoom and transparency settings for maps.

🍽️ New Restaurant

Order food, eat on-site, or take it to go.

Payment options: cash or bank.

Designed as a quick break spot between deliveries or shifts.

🏥 Starting Point & City Hospital (New)

Spawn point has been moved to the City Hospital.

Entire building redesigned: waiting rooms, emergency, private rooms, surgery areas, and ambulance entry/exit system.

🔧 Server & Game Optimizations

Deep server optimizations reduce disconnects and lag during peak hours.

In-game optimizations minimize FPS drops, stutters, and micro-freezes.

Multiplayer encounters in busy city centers now run much smoother.

Result: overall smoother, more stable gameplay even on lower-end systems.

🤖 Removal of NPCs

The outdated NPC system has been completely removed.

Heavy AI processing that strained performance has been eliminated.

Replaced with a more player-focused and optimized flow.

🚗 Vehicle System Improvements

Input lag and responsiveness issues while driving have been reduced.

Vehicle synchronization in multiplayer has been improved.

Physics balances updated: acceleration, braking, and turning feel more natural.

🔫 Weapon System Adjustments

Hit detection delays fixed.

General stability improved.

Balance tweaks applied to certain weapons for fairer performance.

💻 System & UI

Memory leak issues fixed, reducing performance loss in long sessions.

Banking interface fully restored: transfers, deposits/withdrawals, and social payments now run smoothly.

Rare freeze issue in market shopping resolved.

Visual polish and minor bug fixes across menus for a cleaner look.

📌 General Fixes & Improvements

Save system improved, reducing risk of data loss.

Mission marker inconsistencies corrected.

Old performance-draining code paths updated.

Various bug fixes and crash resolutions applied.

🎯 Why It Matters
v1.10.6 is not just a content update — it’s a solid foundation for future versions.

Smoother experience

More realistic systems

Stronger infrastructure

More stable performance

A city environment free of unnecessary NPC strain

🕹️ Quick Tips

World Map: TAB

Waypoint: Click a point on the map → Set Waypoint

From mission: Mission Panel → Create Route

Your feedback is invaluable to us. Keep sharing your map/route suggestions, restaurant menu requests, and any issues you encounter.

Enjoy the game! 🎮

notes.title: Realife Simulator v1.10.5 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Realife Simulator v1.10.5 
Hey everyone v1.10.5 is ready to go. This build focuses on traffic stability, lower server latency, smoother character flow, and a bank UI refresh. Plus: a new delivery job and lots of polish.

🚗 Traffic & NPCs

Natural traffic movement: vehicles no longer move like they’re in slow motion; acceleration, braking and lane changes feel much more natural now.

No more instant spawns: cars spawn gradually and at sensible distances—no more “popping” on top of you.

Reduced chance of getting stuck or “bouncing” after contacts.

🖥️ Performance & Server

Fixed flows that caused unnecessary lag on the server; trimmed network traffic and replication overhead.

Lower and more stable latency (ms) during peak moments; faster recovery on packet hiccups.

General optimization pass: lighter ticks, tuned LOD/streaming.

🧍 Character & Gameplay

Animation polish: walk/run transitions, idle turns, and small hand/shoulder offsets cleaned up.

New starting location: you now spawn at City Hall and can grab your ID immediately.

Various one-off glitches in menus/interactions fixed.

🌦️ Weather

Rebalanced to feel more realistic: better transition speeds, intensity ranges, and day-time behavior.

🗺️ World

Fixed map fall-throughs (holes/voids); collider gaps closed and navmesh updated.

📦 Jobs

New Delivery Job with clearer guidance and tuned time/reward balance.

🏦 Bank & UI

Bank screen redesigned—more modern, clean layout; common actions take fewer clicks.

Added Social Support option in the bank (eligibility/flow shown in the UI).

Feedback
I’ll be watching the first hours closely. If you hit an issue, drop a short note/screenshot—I’ll jump on it fast. Enjoy!

notes.title: 🔧 Realife Simulator – Update v1.10.4 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hello Realife Community,

With the release of version v1.10.4, we're introducing a more immersive and responsive urban simulation experience. This update focuses on performance improvements, realism in gameplay, and long-requested features that bring our vision for Realife Simulator even closer to reality.

🚦 Key Features & Additions
🧠 Traffic NPC System: The city now has life on the roads! AI-controlled vehicles follow dynamic traffic paths, creating a realistic and constantly moving environment. This brings traffic behavior one step closer to a living simulation.

🔊 Vehicle Collision Sounds: All vehicles now generate realistic sound effects during crashes and impacts, adding more depth and feedback to driving scenarios.

⚙️ Technical Improvements & Fixes
🎯 Performance Optimization: Major optimization pass across the map — improved FPS and smoother gameplay, especially in crowded urban zones.

🐞 Bug Fixes: Based on community reports, we resolved multiple critical bugs affecting jobs, vehicle systems, UI glitches, and unexpected disconnections.

🚘 Refined Vehicle Physics: Enhanced driving dynamics — braking, acceleration, and handling have been rebalanced for a more natural experience.

🌓 Day-Night Cycle & Weather Fixes: Fixed sudden lighting jumps and synchronization issues. Visual transitions are now smoother and more immersive.

🎡 Park & Supermarket Stability Boost: Performance issues around high-load zones like the amusement park and shops have been addressed.

⚠️ Important Notice
This version includes deep-level backend changes to core systems. As a result, some players may experience temporary crashes, connection losses, or data sync issues. We are aware of these possibilities and are actively monitoring all systems. Please remain patient during this transition and report any irregularities to us directly.

📌 What’s Next (v1.10.5 & Beyond)
Player-to-player interactive mission system

New career paths & certification features

Advanced citizen ID and verification system

Dynamic real-time events across the map

Biometric login (face recognition – in testing)

Every update brings us one step closer to building a truly living world. Realife Simulator is more than a game it’s a social simulation, a vision, and your story in motion.
Thank you for your continuous support and passion. Keep exploring, keep building.

notes.title: Realife Simulator – v1.10.3 Update Notes (Hotfix)
notes.content:
One step closer to reality. Infrastructure renewed, system stability improved, and gameplay deepened.

🚚 Trailer Missions Stabilized
Fixed an issue where trailers would disappear after passing certain areas during truck delivery missions.

Trailers are now no longer affected by World Partition and remain consistently visible throughout the task.

General performance and synchronization of trailer missions have been improved.

🧾 New Banking Interface
The entire banking system has been redesigned from the ground up.

Introduced a modern flat UI, STG Bank-style card layout, transaction history, and live balance display.

All transactions are now 100% token-secured and encrypted.

Deposit and withdrawal processes have been optimized, and invalid actions are now blocked.

🛂 Identity System v2 – Citizenship & Criminal Record
The updated identity system now includes citizenship history and criminal records.

Crimes committed by players, identity details, and verification status can now be viewed through both the launcher and the web panel.

Police can now officially assign crimes to players, fully integrated with the backend system.

🌐 Advanced Web Integrations
Unreal Engine ↔ PHP ↔ HTML ↔ MySQL backend fully optimized.

Identity verification, job switching, and bank applications are now live, secure, and fully accessible from the web.

A new virtual address structure and enhanced token system have been implemented for maximum reliability.

🔧 General Improvements
In addition to trailer despawn fixes, server disconnect issues in specific map zones have been resolved.

Performance across all systems has been enhanced for a smoother and more stable gameplay experience.

Players can now change their job every 40 minutes.

Spawned actors are no longer removed automatically by World Partition.

Bank account application and evaluation screens have been visually and structurally upgraded.

notes.title: Update v1.10.2
notes.content:
🛠️ Realife Simulator v1.10.2 Update Notes
Hello citizens!

With update v1.10.1, we’ve taken a big step forward in making Realife Simulator more stable, smoother, and more immersive. Based on community feedback, we’ve focused this patch on performance, usability, and realism. Here’s what’s new:

🏛️ New Features:
City Hall Interior Reworked: The entire interior of the municipal building has been redesigned with a more modern and interactive layout.

Citizenship Verification NPC Added: You can now verify your citizenship from the new NPC located on the upper floor of City Hall.

Dynamic Weather System Activated: Weather conditions now change dynamically throughout the day. A sunny morning might turn into a stormy evening!

🚚 Truck Spawning Feature Added: You can now spawn and use trucks! (This feature is still in development — you may encounter a few bugs, which we are actively working to resolve.)

⚙️ Performance & Stability:
Major optimization of RAM, CPU, and GPU usage.

Freezing, stuttering, and FPS drops have been significantly reduced.

LOD issues with characters and vehicles have been fixed.

Inconsistent vehicle behavior and driving instability issues have been resolved.

General graphics and lighting have been improved for a more consistent visual experience.

🛒 Market & HUD Fixes:
The water and juice purchase buttons in the market now work properly.

Multiple bugs on the HUD were resolved, including disappearing UI elements.

Task indicators and button animations are now more stable and responsive.

With this update, we aimed to deliver a smoother and more immersive experience for both new and returning players. Most importantly — we’re listening to you, and development continues.

See you in the next major update!

✅ Parking lot lights have been added to the supermarket
✅ Fixed an issue causing irregular character movement
✅ Resolved the bug preventing players from purchasing water and drinks at the market – it now works as intended
✅ Several bugs in the salary system have been fixed

✅ Fixed the bug where players couldn’t board the spawned truck – you can now enter it without any issues

📅 See you in the next patch!

notes.title: Update v1.10.0
notes.content: [p]Hello Player's![/p][p]We’re actively working on the V1.10.0 update for Realife Simulator. This version will introduce several new features, improvements, and critical bug fixes.[/p][p]🛠️ Update Notes:[/p][p]-Added New Main Menu Music[/p][p]-Vehicle physics have been further improved for a more realistic driving experience.[/p][p]-Several buggy HUD elements have been fixed.[/p][p]-The Health and Thirst bars have been redesigned with a more modern look.[/p][p]-Fixed character-related bugs such as random falling or physical glitches.[/p][p]-Player spawn point has been changed — you’ll now start directly across from the City Hall.[/p][p]-The robbery system has been overhauled and major bugs have been resolved.[/p][p]-Fixed salary system issues; payouts now function correctly.[/p][p]-Bank system and money transfer mechanics have been updated with added security measures.[/p][p]-All player-to-player money transfers are now logged and recorded.[/p][p]-Fixed various map issues such as terrain (landscape) overflow.[/p][p]-Optimization issues have been addressed.[/p][p]-A brand new Truck Driving job has been added! You can now start this job in front of the City Hall and make deliveries to the port.[/p][p]-The ID System has been implemented. When you first join the game, pressing Backspace will show that your ID is not verified. To verify your ID, you must visit the Citizen Registration Office — otherwise, you’ll be flagged as a criminal.[/p][p]🎯 Note:[/p][p]The reason for the slight delay in releasing updates is because we are carefully polishing every detail. My goal is to offer you the most realistic and immersive roleplay experience possible.[/p][p]If you have any questions, issues, or suggestions, don’t hesitate to contact me. Your feedback is what keeps Realife Simulator growing stronger every day!Thanks for your continued support 💙[/p]

notes.title: Update 1.0.9
notes.content:
🛠️ Realife Simulator - Update 1.09 is Live Now!
Hello Realife players!
Update 1.09 is here with major performance improvements, stunning visual upgrades, and brand-new content! Thanks to your feedback, we've revamped core systems and taken the game one step closer to the ultimate life simulation.

🔧 Highlights of This Update:
🎮 Performance & Optimization Boost

Overall performance has been significantly improved. Enjoy smoother gameplay and better FPS across all systems.

💡 Lumen Lighting Technology

We’ve transitioned to Lumen for global illumination! Expect more realistic lighting, dynamic reflections, and a true next-gen visual experience.

🖼️ Graphics Upgrade

Visual fidelity has been enhanced. New textures, improved materials, and environmental effects bring Realife to life like never before.

🔫 Robbery System Reworked

The robbery system has been completely reimagined with new mechanics, better rewards, and a more immersive experience.

🎥 Pickup Vehicle Camera Fix

Fixed a long-standing bug with the camera view in pickup trucks. Driving just got smoother and more reliable!

🎡 Brand-New Amusement Park Added

A fun new area has arrived: Lunapark! Explore rides like ferris wheels and carousels – just don’t forget to take a break from your missions!

🖥️ Revamped User Interface

The UI has been redesigned with a clean, modern look. Navigating menus and interacting with the world is now more intuitive and visually pleasing.

🧍 Character Bugs Fixed

All known character-related issues have been addressed, including animation glitches and visual bugs.

📉 Lag and Latency Improvements

Network-related lag issues have been greatly reduced. Your online experience will now be more stable and responsive.

🛒 Market & Player Start Locations Changed

Player spawn points and market locations have been strategically relocated for better flow and accessibility.

✨ And Much More...

Camera system improvements

Enhanced sound and ambient effects

Minor bug fixes

New music tracks and sound effects

notes.title: 📢 Realife Simulator – Major Update Released! v1.0.8
notes.content:
Hey everyone!
It's been a while since our last update – we’ve been working hard behind the scenes to bring you the biggest improvements so far. Here's what’s new:

🔄 Core Changes:
🔐 New Login System: The entire login screen has been redesigned for a smoother experience.

⚠️ Account Reset: All user data has been reset. You’ll need to re-register and reconnect to the game. We know it’s a big step, but it was essential for upcoming features.

🚀 Gameplay & Systems:
📊 Optimized Performance: Better frame rates, faster loading times.

📦 Overhauled Loading Screen: A fresh look and quicker loading.

🚘 Driver’s License System: You now need a license to rent a car. No more unlicensed drivers on the road!

🏦 New Bank System: Fully interactive banking – manage your money like in real life.

🧑‍💼 New Profession Screen: Switching careers is now much easier and visually improved.

🌆 World & UI Updates:
🚶‍♂️ Realistic NPCs: All waiting NPCs have been replaced with more lifelike characters.

🚦 Updated Traffic System: New AI vehicles and more dynamic car behavior.

🖥️ Online HUD System: All HUDs are now online-based for more accuracy and live sync.

🎮 Character & Vehicle Fixes: Bugs fixed, smoother gameplay.

🎨 Graphics Improvements: Better visuals and atmosphere.

We’re excited to bring even more in the next update.
Thanks for being part of our community! 💙

See you on the road! 🚗💨

notes.title: Upcoming update information
notes.content:
I'm excited to say that I'm working on a big update, I'm working on two systems now, it's a bit tiring but it seems to be going well, I'll be talking about some important things below and I hope this makes you happy.

-We made some updates to the game mechanics npc and physics and now they are smoother and work better.
-We decided to add some NPCs that walk on the road, although it is still in the testing phase, it is going well, but there are no ragdoll and dying animations yet, they will be the next work.
-We are working on the vehicle fuel system to increase this realism.
-The weather and sky system has been overhauled and made more realistic.

Big update we are working on;

-All player data is being changed and now all your data will be kept securely in the database.
-Real time banking system is being developed, you can make deposits and withdrawals from your account. You will also be able to send money to other players.
-All professions are now controlled through the database, when the profession id is given, your profession will be changing at the same time.
-You will be spawned wherever you stayed in your last region location when you enter the game.
-Car rental system now when you rent a car, you will only be able to use it for a certain period of time, when the time is over, the car will disappear and you will stay in the region you are in.
What we want to do in future updates.
-I am working on this intensely, you will be able to create your own dedicated server like Fivem and play with the game's files and modding and more additions.
And there are many more things, see you in the future.

notes.title: Update 1.0.6
notes.content:
Hello, we are aware that we made optimization errors in the previous update we sent. We are trying to solve this error as soon as possible, or rather we have solved it, but we are testing it. Please be patient until the update arrives. Some new features.

We decided to use WP for the best optimization and now we are getting much better fps and lower ms.

Vehicle physics have been revised, Gayal has a better physics and has become a realistic SUV.

Added new car like Etron model.

Office and supermarket were recaptured

The hospital was removed due to some problems.

A new map has been added, you can visit it from across the bridge.

The bridge ambience has been reworked and now different colors and animations have been added.

Character gender system has been reworked

Vehicles in traffic have been optimized again and now work more stable.

The music in the main menu and loading screen has been changed

The loading screen will no longer require you to click anything as it will automatically connect you to the game.


That's all for now, see you in the next update.

notes.title: New Big Update #1
notes.content:
[b]Hello, Realife Simulator players![/b]

We’re excited to bring you a new update packed with fresh features and improvements. Here’s what’s new in this version:

[b]New Features[/b]
[b]Car Rental System:[/b] Your character can now rent a car whenever needed! Explore the city with a variety of vehicle options for a more dynamic experience.
[b]Enhanced Character Mechanics: [/b]Character movements are now smoother, with added interaction options, allowing for a more realistic day-to-day experience.
[b]Map Updates[/b]
[b]New Areas:[/b] New locations and interactive zones have been added to the map. The city is now more vibrant, offering more places to explore.
Optimization Improvements: We’ve made performance optimizations for a faster loading experience and smoother gameplay.
[b]Trees added:[/b] Different trees and vegetation have been added to the necessary places on the map. You will be able to perform photosynthesis in certain places.



[b]Improvements and Fixes[/b]
[b]Enhanced Graphics and Visual Quality:[/b] Improved graphics make the environment and characters look more lively and detailed.
[b]Bug Fixes:[/b] Thanks to feedback from our community, various bugs have been fixed to ensure a better gaming experience.
Your feedback is invaluable to us! Enjoy the new features, and let us know your thoughts. Have fun in the world of Realife Simulator!
[b]Fps Optimization:[/b] FPS has been greatly improved, bugs and sudden fps drops have been fixed.

-Npc added to the market (you can shop).

-Fixed optimization issues and crashes in the game.
-New roads and traffic signs have been added.
-Shopping system has been introduced.
-Car rental has been added and you will be able to rent a car for a few hours (being tested).
-Added more realistic and new buildings to the city.
-The vehicle system has been overhauled again (in testing)
